design_philosophy.visual_style: Deep Obsidian backgrounds, high-end glassmorphism, neon data accents
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Fintech precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics
Content is King: Data visualization is the hero
Negative Space: Luxurious breathing room for metrics

usage_rules: Headings (Outfit): Use for Page Titles, Card Headers, Big Metrics. Tracking-tight.
Body (Manrope): Use for all UI text, tables, inputs. Excellent for numbers.
Mono (JetBrains): Use for transaction IDs, API keys, or code snippets.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B: High Density)

structure.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, glass effect, border-r border-white/5

cards.classes: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-xl hover:border-white/20 transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)] rounded-lg font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10 backdrop-blur-md rounded-lg transition-all

inputs.classes: bg-black/20 border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600 rounded-lg h-10

tables.header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 font-semibold bg-white/5
tables.row: border-b border-white/5 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors text-sm text-slate-300

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: url('/assets/noise.png') opacity-5 mix-blend-overlay pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50

login_bg.usage: Login page background with heavy overlay (bg-black/80)

dashboard_texture.usage: Subtle texture for sidebar or cards (optional)

universal_guidelines: THEME: STRICT DARK MODE. Do not implement light mode toggles.
CONTRAST: Ensure text is readable against dark backgrounds. Use Slate-400 for secondary text, not Slate-600.
GLASSMORPHISM: Do not overuse. Use it for containers (Cards, Sidebar, Header). Content inside should be clean.
DATA-TESTID: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
RESPONSIVENESS: Mobile-first. Sidebar becomes a drawer on mobile.
LANGUAGE: Portuguese (pt-BR) for all UI text.
NO GRADIENT TEXT: Keep text solid white or slate for readability. Use gradients only for borders or icons.
SHADCN: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Glass' aesthetic. Remove default white backgrounds and replace with bg-white/5.

setup: Configure tailwind.config.js with the new color palette.
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Sidebar and Glass background.
pages: Login: Full screen image with heavy dark overlay. Centered glass card.
Dashboard: Bento grid layout. Top cards for summary. Middle large chart. Bottom lists.
Transactions (Receitas/Despesas): Data table with filters. Add/Edit via Dialog (Modal).
Reports: Focus on Charts (AreaChart, BarChart, PieChart).
